title: Seiko 5 Sports Automatic Watch SRPD51
description_en: The Seiko 5 Sports is Japan's most popular automatic watch — no battery ever needed, as the movement winds itself from your wrist's motion. In-house 4R36 caliber, 100m water resistance, day-date display. A modern classic at an unbeatable Japan price.
description_ja: セイコー5スポーツは日本で最も愛される自動巻き時計。電池不要で手首の動きで自動巻き上げ。自社製4R36ムーブメント・100m防水・デイデイト表示を搭載した現代の名品。
